name: Iron Holds
worldbuilding: Subterranean kingdoms, mountain citadels, industrial fortress-cities, and heavily defended clan holdings. They emphasize engineering, fortifications, firearms, and resilient infantry.

factionRule.name: Entrenched
factionRule.effect: Friendly Units that did not Move during the preceding Movement Phase gain Tough 1 against Ranged attacks.

factionCommands.name: Hold the Line
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an Attack, it gains Tough 2 against the triggering Attack only. This does not persist for other Attacks.

factionCommands.name: Concentrated Volley
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 2 on its next ranged Attack this Phase, provided it did not voluntarily Move in the preceding Movement Phase.

factionCommands.name: Prepared Position
factionCommands.effect: During the active Unit's Movement activation, it may forgo its normal Move to gain Cover 2 against Ranged Attacks until the beginning of its next Movement activation. This is an explicit Cover benefit even without a barricade; no terrain is created. Disengaging or another voluntary Move this Round ends the benefit.

factionCommands.name: Counterbattery Orders
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Ranged 4 or Anti-Artillery 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Shieldwall
abilities.effect: If stationary during the preceding Movement Phase, gain Brace 1 until the next Movement Phase.

abilities.name: Lock Shields
abilities.effect: When this Unit is successfully Charged, spend 1 CP. Gain Brace 2 against that Charge's one Impact pool, additive with any applicable Brace 1 from Shieldwall. This does not stop the Charge or the charging Unit's later melee Attack.

abilities.name: Drilled Volley
abilities.effect: If stationary during the preceding Movement phase, gain Accurate 1 when making a ranged Attack.

abilities.name: Controlled Crossfire
abilities.effect: While this Unit did not voluntarily Move in the preceding Movement Phase, its Ranged Attacks gain Pinpoint.

abilities.name: Drilled Repeaters
abilities.effect: If this Unit did not voluntarily Move during the preceding Movement Phase, its Repeater Rifles improve Hit from 5+ to 4+ for this Attack. Its existing Controlled Crossfire rule still grants Pinpoint when stationary.

abilities.name: Anchor the Line
abilities.effect: One friendly Infantry Unit within Short cannot be displaced by enemy abilities until the end of the Round and may adjust its facing or formation without making a Move.

abilities.name: Rune of Shelter
abilities.effect: Grant Ward 6+ against Magic to a friendly Unit within Short, or improve its existing Magic Ward by one step until the end of the Round.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.effect: One unit within Short with an attack profile that has Heavy gains +2 Attacks. If it Blunders, its Unit suffers Direct Damage 1.

abilities.name: Armored Engine
abilities.effect: Reduce the first Damage suffered each Round by 1.

abilities.name: Grounded Platform
abilities.effect: Gain Accurate 1 on Bombard Attacks if stationary during the preceding Movement phase.

upgrades.name: Airburst Bombardment
upgrades.effect: During its Movement activation, the Great Bombard may prepare an Airburst Bombardment instead of moving. Place a 25mm token within 18". At the end of the Assault Phase, every Unit with at least half its surviving Models (rounded up) within 1" of the token suffers two automatic Physical Hits at Damage 1 total. Resolve Armor then Ward; no Evade. Resolve Saves normally. The Great Bombard cannot use its Bombard Attack during the Assault Phase of this Round. Remove the token after resolving the effect.

abilities.name: King's Standard
abilities.effect: Friendly Infantry within Short count as one additional Model for determining whether they meet a rule's minimum Unit-size requirement, but gain no actual Models, Attacks, or Wounds.

abilities.name: Oaths of Stone
abilities.effect: Up to three friendly Units within Medium each reduce the first Damage they suffer during the remainder of the Round by 1.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Line Infantry, Longbowmen, generic Engineers, Scouts, and lighter cavalry. Thunderers are strong stationary gunners, but generic ranged troops are more adaptable.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Deep Watch as the faction's Extra Core, a second stationary-gunline Ranged unit reinforcing the Entrenched/Firing Line identity rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on Musket and Heirloom Axe, Anti-Monster on the Steam Bastion's Heavy Cannon) or an improved Hit (Hand Cannon 4+ -> 3+).
